title: Model Theory for Operators Related to Square Roots of Normal Operators
summary: In this paper we prove that a square root of a cyclic normal operator is unitarily equivalent to a block multiplication operator on a vector-valued Lebesgue space with a $2$--normal symbol. In addition, we show that a cyclic operator which admits a cyclic $2$--normal extension is unitarily equivalent to a block multiplication operator on a corresponding vector-valued Hardy space with $2$--normal symbol.
